halfLife.notes: Once-nightly dosing typical due to sedating effect at lower doses. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

activeMetabolite.name: Desmethylmirtazapine
activeMetabolite.notes: Approximately 10% of parent activity. Not clinically significant for switching. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

cypInteractions.switchingRelevance: No meaningful CYP inhibition. Mirtazapine is sometimes added to SSRIs/SNRIs for augmentation; cross-titration is comparatively safe but watch for sedation, weight gain, and rare neutropenia. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

maoiWashout.notes: Standard 14-day washout in both directions. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

discontinuationSyndromeRisk.notes: Low discontinuation risk; rebound insomnia and anxiety can occur after abrupt cessation. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

formulationNotes: Tablets and orodispersible tablets available. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.
